== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Night Wheel]] [[the Valley|Valley]] is a sacred training territory belonging to the [[Akura clan]]. It serves as a high-stakes environment designed for growth, specifically intended for young [[Truegold|Truegolds]] aiming to reach the [[Underlord]] stage and for [[Underlord|Underlords]] seeking to expand their power. The valley is characterized by its immense spiritual energy, which can feel as overwhelming as an ocean of power, and it is often shrouded in [[Shadow|shadow]]. While the area contains significant opportunities and valuable treasures, it is also a place of extreme danger. The landscape features dark trees, brown grass, and petrified vines, often illuminated by a spectral green light or various flashes of power. Within the valley, individuals may encounter wild [[Remnants]] or engage in patrols to defend territorial borders. The region has been the site of competitions between different factions, such as the [[Blackflame Empire]] and the [[Seishen Kingdom]], with the former successfully increasing its number of [[Underlord|Underlords]] during their time there.}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Owned by the [[Akura clan]] for generations, [[Night Wheel]] [[the Valley|Valley]] serves as a sacred training ground and resource gathering site filled with both great opportunity and significant danger. This shadowed location contains forests, sacred grounds, and a castle erected by [[King Dakata]], all of which are characterized by constant rustling and flashing lights. The valley possesses an overwhelming [[shadow aura]] that suppresses [[spirit-sense|spiritual sense]], restricts sight, and makes it difficult to perceive surroundings. Within this environment, the [[Akura clan|Akura family]] regularly harvests resources and utilizes a [[vault]] for training or [[Soulsmithing]]. Despite the pain caused by opening [[Copper sight]] and the difficulty of sensing through the darkness, the valley's [[aura]] feels like diving into an ocean of power, providing a place where even new [[Underlord|Underlords]] have achieved [[advancement]].}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Night Wheel]] [[the Valley|Valley]] served as a site where [[sacred artists]] from the [[Blackflame Empire]] were once transported. The location houses a storehouse maintained by [[Charity]] and is notable as the place where [[Seishen Daji|Daji]] previously utilized his armor. Following their time in the valley, individuals from the [[Seishen Kingdom]] became [[Underlord|Underlords]]. During his own time there, [[Lindon]] suffered a loss of his senses.}}
